notes.title: Tutorial step-by-step, Run history
notes.content:
[h2]Tutorial step-by-step, Run History[/h2]
[b]v.8[/b][list]
[*]Runs now have a score card that calculates a score and saves the run score and details.
[*]From the main menu you can look at your run history scores and major details.
[*]The tutorial button now shines until you have played it the first time.
[*]The tutorial now has optional screen pings for where to click.
[*]Dev note: This is the last of mechanics, content, and polish. I will do some balancing, but will
otherwise be working on marketing between now and the Steam NextFest with plans to release the
game soon afterwards.
[/list]

notes.title: Major style update
notes.content:
[h2]Tarot cards, story boot screen, VFX, SFX, and more![/h2]
[b]v.75[/b][list]
[*]Added tarot card graphics as an option for the hand cards. Unique tarot card art for every single base card.
--Added the preferences option to use the new card art or keep the base easy to read/see cards from before.
[*]Fixed the timing issues with enemies dying on the enemy turn and causing a single enemy to skip their turn.
[*]Added background to the battle scene to be floating in a sea of blinking stars. Adjusted all maps to accommodate.
[*]Added yellow circling rays to the class and race selection screens behind the character portrait. Also victory screen.
[*]Changed the map screen background to be surrealistic and gave it a wavy effect.
[*]Changed the card targeting mechanic to allow for touchscreens.
[*]Added animation to the collapse spawn point action.
[*]Gave the player warp in/warp out animations and SFX for the map and battle screens.
[*]Changed the splash screen to add some background and story to the game.
[*]Added a cloud effect to the main menu screen. 
[*]Fixed some spacing and visual errors on the map screen.
[/list]

notes.title: The great polishing begins!
notes.content:
[h2]Polishing and a bit of bug fixes[/h2]
[b]v.7[/b][list]
[*]When an enemy is taking their turn a large indicator of the type of action and strength of that action show beneath that figure.
[*]Added the floating numbers for all status effects changes.
[*]Fixed a bug with ingots not resetting at the start of a level.
[*]There is a gash animation when the player takes a hit.
[*]Added a glow behind the achievement popup.
[*]A circular VFX appears behind the player when they get an achievement, pretty subtle.
[*]Added a scoring system and score card that appears whenever a run is ended (victory or defeat). 
[*]Plan to create a tracking system so the player can see how well they are doing with each set of class/race/boss.
[*]Added some screen particle to the upgrade card/gear scene. 
[*]Added SFX to the card shuffle effect and changed some of the UI SFXs.
[*]Added rotating rays behind the images in the class and race selection screens. Also the victory screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Content complete for release
notes.content:
[h2]Two new races, one new class, bringing the total to four each![/h2]
[b]v.5[/b][list]
[*]I've decided that four of each run factor (class, race, finale) will be considered feature complete for the launch. I might add more if any particular idea strikes my fancy, but I am not actively going to dedicate brainstorming time to consider new factors.
[*]Added the fourth boss, Spike. Spike retaliates with however much damage he took. On his turn he strikes the player for the last amount he took. He is in a small arena.
[*]All cards have SFX.
[*]All gear has SFX.
[*]All bosses now have SFX.
[*]Each map type now has "unique" background music. 
[*]Changes some of the SFX to be less annoying.
	-Movement is only two steps instead of four.
	-Flute is changed.
	-Select sound is softer.
[*]Added a camera damage shake when the player takes damage. The velocity of the shake depends on how much damage the player took.
[*]Added VFX to enemy death along with a death yelp. The enemy fades out under the VFX.
[*]Fixed a bug with wands where they were not resetting to base damage each time they were used.
[*]Created floating damage numbers above enemies when they take damage. At the moment only the first hit registers, but I have a plan for how to fix (will detach and instantiate a damage "scene" for each hit).
[*]Have plans to add floating number for the player when they take damage, add block, heal, add move, etc. 
[*]Plan to adjust the target selection so that the game works properly on touch screen instead of needing to drag the cursor.

From now until Steam Next Fest in Feb, I plan on working solely on polish, fixes, and balance. And relaxing a bit for the holidays! 
[/list]

notes.title: More content: 2 new races, 1 new class
notes.content:
[h2]Two new races, one new class, bringing the total to four each![/h2]
[list]
[*]Created the sloth race, doesn't get boots but gets 1 MP every card played. 
[*]Soulreaper race added, doesn't get achievements, gear, card, or class upgrades. Instead can absorb the strength of his enemies. 
[*]Started work on the BladeDancer class. Two of the gear slots are taken up by stances. Only one stance is active at a time and it modifies the effects of the offensive and defensive card.
[*]Added some sound effects (SFX)
[/list]

notes.title: New Class: Craftsman
notes.content:
[h2]Brand new class: Craftsman[/h2]
[list]
[*]Created the craftsman class. The class has gear that is generally weaker than other class gear but is enhanced by what activation symbols is on the card to grant bonus buffs.
[*]Created the barricade obstacle which gives an adjacent hero a bonus damage resistance on the turn it is placed. 
[*]Fixed how the DreamMaster finale deals with non-enemy nodes tagged as enemy.
[*]Fixed the bug that was allowing double enemy turns when an enemy died on their activation.
[/list]

notes.title: New Finale: Illusionist, Attunist class complete
notes.content:
[h2]Demo and Tutorial complete[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made Hard and Impossible more difficult than Normal.
[*]Completed advanced gear for Attunist class. It is now fully playable.
[*]Fixed bug that was allowing bonuses from dead enemies.
[*]Provide days left and finale boss notification in the victory screen to allow for selecting upgrades.
[*]Created a new finale featuring the illusionist. The illusionist teleports at the start of their turn or when hit leaving behind goblins as he departs.
[/list]

notes.title: Full Tutorial and Demo complete!
notes.content:
[h1]If you've been waiting for more development to give this game the next pass this is the time!!![/h1]
[list]
[h2]Demo and Tutorial complete[/h2]
[*]Demo and tutorial are in place and work!
[*]New (useless) items created to ease the player into each of the game's concepts.
[*]Tutorial uses scripted events, cards, spawns, and text to show key concepts.
[*]Demo mode has limited subset of in-game achievements.
[*]Camera will only zoom in-out once when the mouse is hovered over the combat log area of the screen.
[*]In the demo area the enemies scale up by a mission day each turn. Spawn rate is also a base spawn of the turn number.
-This is meant to be a fun little demonstration of the core game mechanics.
[*]Added social media buttons to the player died screen.
[*]Based on playtester feedback added a display to the map screen showing days left until finale.
[*]Removed the enemy shake on hit animation for the time being. Too janky when cards could hit groups of enemies multiple times.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix week!
notes.content:
[list]

[h2]Bug fix week![/h2]
[*] Refactored text strings so combat log should use more natural language. The changes will allow Asian languages to be added better in the future.
[*] Removed the German language option as it served it's purpose until a full translation push happens closer to release (basically making sure I could implement localization easily and not have to go through the entire codebase/all text nodes near the end).
[*] Bug fix: enemies stop after the player dies.
[*] Bug fix: Player movement tile options handle visibility checks better, should be close to perfect.
[*] Added stop points to the enemy actions to prevent multiple enemy actions functions from firing off at the same time.
[*] On player death a screenshot is taken and the combat log is exported to the player folder. This can be sent to me for checking for errors/bugs.
[*] Clear the player's movement points and block when exiting to the main menu. The player could play two movement cards, exit, re-enter play two movement cards, exit, enter to get infinite move and block on the first combat turn.
[*] Added VFX to active cards, gear that is actively targeting, and active enemies during their turn. Removed the active card going to the center of the screen blocking the player's view.
[*] Bug fix: fixed the class upgrades only giving the player the first card (even if they selected the second).
[*] Added achievement popup to the main battle page and the map screen so players can check for achievements before making decisions. 
[*] Added a give feedback button that leads to a google form.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements and class level ups
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes for v.05[/h1]
[list]
[*]Achievements in steam and within game!
[*]Player is awarded a class upgrade upon 4, 7, and 10 achievements. 
[*]Each class card has an upgrade and then each class has six permanent upgrades on offer (2 at a time). If you skip one you won't see it again.
[*]There are generic achievements and then ones for each class and each race.
[*]Gear that is usable a limited number of times a turn or a mission now has usage bubbles. Green ones for per turn uses, red for per mission uses. When that gear is used the bubble will turn black. Green ones will reset at the start of the next player turn.
[*]Race and class cards with events have been given a purple hexagonal amythest icon. So has the player. This is a visual indicator that those cards can be played for an event. 
[*]Goblin Champion now has 2 damage resistance.
[*]Normal difficulty levels have been bumped up. Will work on other difficulty levels later. Still pretty easy for me to win at normal with the soldier.
[*]Quite a bit of player power creep with the new class upgrades. These push the exponential growth up as desired. Just need to bump enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: User feedback changes and start of achievement
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes for v.04[/h1]
[list]
[*]Movement activation no longer checks for visibility to adjacent tiles, player should now always be able to move to a valid space even if the raycast bugs out it might just take two steps.
[*]Created several achievements in Steam and their cooresponding resources in game. Including art assets.
[*]Balanced out the base cards. Brought the power levels to be roughly even (as far as I can tell so far) for the given tiers.
[*]Tier III for Might, Spirit, and Wit all have an in hand effect. Agility has two (because it is associated with both range and move). Wisdom doesn't have one (+Attacks is too powerful).
[*]Visual changes based on playtester feedback:
--Added action type gems to the gear panels.
--Added emerald triangles to the map object that can be interacted with.
--Got rid of the fancy font and reduced font sizes generally.
--Revamped the upgrade screen so instead of two pages for cards there is a single page with all six options (and the base card upgraded from) visible at once with navigable buttons for selection.
--Increased the redness of damaged enemy figures.
--Increased the base damage of horn bash to 4.
[*]Now tracking mission and run totals for a bunch of statistics and displaying them on the victory screen. Will tie into achievements and job upgrades.
[*]Revamped the enemy stat block to be less intrusive. Numbers are smaller, no icons, color coded, and they run along the side of the enemy.
[/list]

[h2]Designer intent for the base card balances:[/h2]
Three of the level 2 upgrades for the base card types have an in-hand boost. That means so long as the card is in the players hand they have that benefit. One has none, and the other has two in hand effects. The rest of the effects are a mix of bonuses when played and for the remainder of the turn. It is intended that the player will choose one in-hand bonus as core to their build and choose the remainder as in play bonuses. I want the player to have end state builds of (1) level 2 + (4) level 1 as valid as (3) level 2s. Might have to boost the level 1 effects to achieve that later.

notes.title: Keyboard and Controller support
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes for v.03[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated the game to add both keyboard and controller support to the entire game.
[*] Menus are navigable using any method.
[*] Controls in battle are dynamic and context specific:
 --When in movement mode D-pad moves the player
 --When in the base state D-pad cycles through cards to play
 --With a card selected D-pad cycles through gear/player/map elements 
[*] Keyboard shortcuts for cards and gear/player.
 --This should be the fastest way to play when combined with mouse, for example 1 selects the first card, the ` key selects the player, and a single mouse click attacks. Holding down Q and hitting R ends the turn.
[*] Pressing C or the select menu shows the controller/keyboard mapping with icons. 
[*] Having the movement state feels smoother with the ability to use WASD/D-pad.
[*] Added a button for patch notes to the main menu screen.
[*] Adding the context states to the main battle flow solved some problems with end turn.
[/list]

notes.title: Sept 29 gameplay update
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]Updated the main trailer on the steam page to use the live version of the boss fight as well as the updated art in the game. The trailer no longer has placeholder panel container art or placeholder gear.
[*]Found the setting to outline all the text in a thin black line, this should help with readability.
[*]Lots of new functionality has been added to gear. 
-Upgraded gear can now provide additional bonuses at start of the turn, 
-thorns and damage resistance have been added to gear effects.
-Shield and armor automatic block added as a start of turn effect instead of a trigger/react
-Gear can trigger effects on enemy death or if that particular gear kills an enemy.
-Thorns exists as a player effect in addition to triggers on enemy moving adjacent.
[*]Added the ability for targeting to include all enemies within a certain range of the hero, this area can be increased due to increased range effects. Heavy sword, bell, and Claymore shifted to use this targeting mechanism
[*]Massive overhaul to the help pages. Now it is an entire book with animated videos and still images to help the player understand what is going on, likely things will have to be added to these as feedback comes in.
[*]Decided to leave the release version with six normal levels then a finale. The first three levels will use the small maps, the second three will use the large maps for an escalating scope of the battles.
[*]Converted all text strings in game to use key_ids for future localization. With much of the Steam traffic coming from Asia and Eastern Europe I want at least Russian, Chinese, and Japanese to be there on actual release. For now I have only added German as two of my main playtesters are fluent in German. 
[*]Language preference is set by the operating system, but users are able to select from available languages from a dropdown at the main menu, it will save (and load on game start) this choice in a seperate config file. 
[*]As part of the localization pass there was a complete pass through of all lines of code that write to the combat log. Most of the double and confusing combat logs should now be much more clear and follow a standard format.
[/olist]

notes.title: Sept 22 gameplay update
notes.content:
New Features:
-Added a new boss, LavaMan. LavaMan takes a maximum of 1 damage from any hit so heroes need to be able to do damage multiple times to wear him down. He reduces the heroes health and max health by an increasing amount each turn.
-Added the new attunist class. The attunist relies on a variety of magic items to survive.
-Created three new large maps, including one with doors (a new feature).
-Maps are sorted into pools based on size with only small maps being chosen for the first three days, the next three days both small and large maps can be pulled, days 7-9 only large maps.
-Damage resistance is now a stat for enemies to be able to fine tune difficulty.

Balance and fixes:
-Card text size is dynamic so the upgraded card text will now fit on the cards properly.
-Some tweaking of the difficulty settings.
-The finale boss is set at the beginning of the run and depending on difficulty will be displayed on the map screen. This will allow characters to plan upgrade paths to deal with the challenges of a particular boss. 

Design notes:
-The first boss, DreamMaster, is meant to challenge a heroes ability to deal relatively high levels of damage over a sustained period by ensuring there is a champion on the map at all times and requiring their defeat to win. This boss, LavaMan is designed to have the player perform multiple hits due to his maximum damage per hit of 1. Future bosses will require a different build considerations. 
-Goblin Champion is going down too easily, I added damage resistance to slow down his defeat and will likely need to tweak it up further, but it is still early prototyping days. 
-I want the earlier levels to go faster (perhaps they are still too fast) so segregated the map pools by size. I want the later missions to require a bit more time to beat them.
